resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list spells the lookout Barronette. The lookout history site and Wikipedia's town article use Barronett. The record keeps the list spelling.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1934 build details come from one lookout history site, and the agency and land-survey code come from its Wisconsin index page. The gone status comes from the Forest Fire Lookout Association list at firelookout.org; no source gives a removal date, cause, staffing, fire history, or what remains at the site, and no source gives access status. Height converted from 72 feet (21.9 m). The Wikipedia town (Barronett, Washburn County) is a different place from the unincorporated community of Barronett in Barron County; the sources here refer to Washburn County. Coordinates on the list (45.67394, -91.98040) sit about a kilometre from the Wikipedia town coordinates; the story says only that they are close.
